{{Quote|Leave the miners alone. Show yourself and face me!''"<br />"''The miners are dead.|Medd Tandar and the Huntress|<ref name="DoE" />}}
A '''massacre''' took place in [[980 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]]. Tensions between the planet's [[Doan Royal House|Royal Family]] and [[mining caste]] rose when the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] accidentally [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gerran]] while attempting to capture him. As a result, Gerran's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Serra]], became depressed, prompting her [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], to hire the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] known as "[[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]]" to assassinate [[Gelba]], the [[Mining/Legends|miners']] leader. At the same time, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Medd Tandar]] to mediate the situation between the miners and the Royal Family, as well as to obtain a collection of recently excavated [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]]. During the meeting between Tandar and Gelba, the Huntress attacked, killing the mining leader and the five other miners that were accompanying her. She used her [[Force power/Legends|powers]] to disrupt Tandar's ability to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and killed him as well.

Fearing that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would suspect the Royal Family to have ordered Tandar's assassination, [[Gerran's father|Doan's King]] agreed with Serra that she should travel to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to assure the Jedi that the Royal Family had not been behind the attack. At the Jedi Temple, Serra discovered that [[Caleb|her father]] had been [[Confrontation on Ambria|killed]] by a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[990 BBY|ten years previously]]. Around that time, [[Draado]], the miner who had found the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifacts on Doan, began calling for war with the Royal Family as a result of Gelba's death. Meanwhile, on [[Ciutric IV]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] [[Mission to Doan|sent]] his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], to investigate the death of Tandar.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|They refuse to negotiate with us!''"<br />"''Can you blame them? You killed the crown prince.|Gelba and Tandar|<ref name="DoE" />}}
In the [[Time/Legends|years]] following the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Doan Royal House|Royal House]] of [[Doan]] came into conflict with the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] lower-class [[mining caste]]. [[Gelba]], a leader of the [[Miner/Legends|miners]], ordered the capture of the Doan [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gerran]]. When the [[Mining/Legends|miners]] tried to force Gerran's [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] into an emergency landing, they accidentally destroyed the vehicle, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him and sending his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], Princess [[Serra]], into depression. [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], Serra's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] and a member of the [[Doan Royal Guard]], hoped to remedy Serra of her depression by getting revenge on those who had caused Gerran's death. She traveled to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Paradise (space station)|Paradise]], where she found the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] known as "[[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]]" and hired her to assassinate Gelba.<ref name="DoE" />

===Tandar's mission===
{{Quote|What is being done to your people is wrong. I will do what I can to convince the king to stop his persecution of your people. But I cannot promise anything.|Medd Tandar|<ref name="DoE" />}}
Meanwhile, the miners contacted the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and convinced them to dispatch a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] to help mediate the situation on Doan. After the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] received permission from [[Gerran's father|Doan's King]] to send a Knight to meet with the miners, the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] Jedi Knight [[Medd Tandar]] was dispatched to discuss negotiations between the Royal House and the mining caste. Tandar's main objective, however, was to recover several [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] that had recently been excavated by the miners on Doan.<ref name="DoE" />

Tandar met with Gelba and five other miners along with two of Gelba's bodyguards and three of her top [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] at a [[Doan mining facility|mining facility]] on Doan. There, Gelba began to read off a list of demands that the mining caste had accumulated. Tandar attempted to explain that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] did not have the power to grant the miners their demands, revealing that he did not possess the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate's]] authority to act. Instead, he was only able to negotiate with the Royal Family. Gelba, in turn, revealed that the [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] refused to negotiate with the miners, but Tandar pointed out that the miners were the ones that had killed Gerran. Gelba then accused him of defending the Royal Family, despite the fact that the nobles [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] the miners without trial, [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] them, and even executed those who resisted. When Tandar reinforced his point that he was powerless do anything other than to negotiate, Gelba asked why the Jedi had come at all. He revealed to the miners that he had traveled to Doan mainly to acquire the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifacts. Gelba became indignant, claiming that anything the miners had excavated was rightfully theirs and stated that the Jedi cared more for artifacts than the suffering of living beings.<ref name="DoE" />

==The massacre==
{{Quote|If you surrender, I will promise you a fair trial.''"<br />"''There will be no trial.|Tandar and "the Huntress"|<ref name="DoE" />}}
[[File:Darthcog.jpg|thumb|right|175px|The Huntress]]
Tandar began to reassure Gelba that he would try to help, but his rebuttal suddenly stopped. Sensing a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Jedi announced that someone was coming. The Huntress suddenly arrived and shot Gelba in the chest, killing her instantly. The other five miners scattered, but the Iktotchi assassin quickly shot and murdered two more. Tandar drew his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in response, but as he reached out with the Force, it felt strange and cold to him&mdash;as a blow to the gut&mdash;and he staggered back. The Huntress then fired on him, but Tandar quickly crawled behind a nearby rock formation.<ref name="DoE" />

The surviving miners returned fire on the Huntress from behind their cover, but she quickly dispatched with them. As Tandar tried once more to draw on the Force, he realized that it had been tainted with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. He stepped out and ordered that the assassin show herself. Instead, the Iktotchi just fired a shot at him from the shadows, which he was barely able to deflect. Tandar again tried to envelope himself in the Force, but the Huntress used her own [[Force power/Legends|power]] to interfere with his ability to touch the Force. He ordered that she leave the miners alone and requested once more that she show herself. In response, the Iktotchi assassin stepped out of the shadows and revealed to Tandar that she had already killed the rest of the miners. She then fired on Tandar again, and the Jedi was barely able to dodge her shots.<ref name="DoE" />

Scolding himself for his clumsiness, Tandar [[Telekinesis/Legends|called]] the assassin's [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to him with the Force. To Tandar's surprise, the Iktotchi remained calm. He offered her a fair trial if she surrendered, but the Huntress retorted that there would be no trial and quickly retreated. Tandar realized his mistake, too late, as he saw that she had tricked him and overloaded the weapons' [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]]. As they exploded, he tried to protect himself with a [[Force barrier/Legends|Force shield]], but the dark side continued to interfere with his powers. Unable to protect himself, the Jedi Knight was killed.<ref name="DoE" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|This will all work out. Gelba is dead. My husband is avenged. A quick meeting with one of the Jedi Masters and this whole incident will be behind us.|Serra|<ref name="DoE" />}}
The massacre caused the [[King/Legends|King]] of Doan to fear that the Jedi would believe that the Royal House had ordered Tandar's assassination. As such, the day after the incident, he met with Serra and agreed for her to travel to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant to assure the Jedi Order that the Royal Family was not behind the attack. Lucia later revealed to Serra that she had hired the Huntress, but Serra decided not to report her bodyguard's action. At the Jedi Temple, Serra learned that her father, [[Caleb]], had been [[Confrontation on Ambria|killed]] [[990 BBY|ten years previously]] by a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. She thus had Lucia contact the Huntress to hunt down and [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|capture]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], whom she mistakenly believed to be her father's killer.<ref name="DoE" />

On [[Ciutric IV]], Bane became aware of the death of Tandar and decided to [[Mission to Doan|send]] his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], to investigate as he believed that anyone who was powerful enough to kill a Jedi was worthy of their attention. He also used it as a means for solitude so that he could go on [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|his own secret mission]] to find [[Holocron of Heresies|the holocron]] of [[Darth Andeddu]], which was rumored to hold the secret to [[Essence transfer|immortality]].<ref name="DoE" />

All the while, [[Draado]], the miner on Doan who had dug up the Sith artifacts, became corrupted by the talismans he wore. The artifacts, coupled with Gelba's assassination, caused him to call for war with the Royal Family. Nevertheless, he was killed soon after by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]], who had also traveled to Doan in search of the artifacts.<ref name="DoE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The massacre on Doan appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2009]] novel, ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', the final installment in the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']].<ref name="DoE" />
